name: AI Task Planning Skill
shortDescription: Break a vague business goal into scoped tasks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
longDescription: A planning skill for turning solo-operator goals into executable task files, dependency maps, and verification steps before implementation starts.
problemSolved: Solo founders often start building before the scope, dependencies, and verification gates are clear.
notFor: urgent manual fixes with no planning value
credentialRequirement: None for local planning.
humanApprovalBoundary: The user or Chat Agent approves execution batches before implementation.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Run on a sample blueprint before using it on production code.
implementationSteps: Write the user request into a planning brief.
Break the work into small task files.
examplePrompt: Convert this blueprint into executable task files with dependencies, acceptance criteria, testing requirements, and QA requirements.
exampleOutput: TASK-001: Create data schema; TASK-002: Create seed content; dependency-map.md; blockers.md
whyUseThis: It keeps one-person projects moving without constant interruption
whenNotToUse: When the task is obvious and reversible
When the user only needs a short answer
cheaperAlternative: A manual checklist in a markdown file.
saferAlternative: Require Chat Agent review before any task moves to implementation.

name: AI Research Collector Skill
shortDescription: Collect verified research into structured findings, assumptions, recommendations, and sources.
longDescription: A research skill for turning scattered tool, competitor, or market information into evidence-backed notes that can feed content and product decisions.
problemSolved: Solo operators need research, but raw search results are noisy and easy to forget.
credentialRequirement: Usually none unless researching behind logged-in dashboards.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human review is required before publishing claims or applying to affiliate programs.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Start with public documentation and record source URLs.
implementationSteps: Define the decision the research should support.
examplePrompt: Research affiliate programs for automation tools and separate verified facts from assumptions.
exampleOutput: Verified: tool has public partner program. Assumption: conversion potential is high for comparison pages.
whenNotToUse: When research requires paid/private access you do not have
When a source cannot be verified
saferAlternative: Require source links for every claim used in public copy.

name: AI Writer Skill
shortDescription: Draft practical content that explains decisions, workflows, and implementation steps.
longDescription: A writing skill focused on useful SEO content for solo operators, including decision blocks, alternatives, FAQs, and disclosure-aware monetization sections.
problemSolved: Solo founders need publishing velocity without turning pages into shallow AI filler.
credentialRequirement: None for drafting.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human or Chat Agent review before publishing.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Draft in local files and run QA for thin content and unsupported claims.
implementationSteps: Start from a structured page template.
Use research notes as the claim boundary.
examplePrompt: Draft a comparison outline with winner, best-for blocks, cheaper option, safest option, and FAQ.
exampleOutput: A structured comparison draft that avoids claims not supported by source notes.
whyUseThis: It turns research into publishable assets
It helps maintain consistent page structure
whenNotToUse: When no research exists
When the page needs firsthand testing that has not happened
saferAlternative: Require QA to reject unsupported claims.

name: AI QA Review Skill
shortDescription: Check content or implementation against requirements, blueprint, SEO, safety, and monetization rules.
longDescription: A QA skill for catching thin content, unsupported claims, missing disclosure, missing progress updates, and blueprint drift before a task is accepted.
problemSolved: Solo projects often ship work without a second reviewer.
credentialRequirement: None.
humanApprovalBoundary: Chat Agent decides final acceptance after QA.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Run QA on a sample task and compare against the blueprint.
implementationSteps: Compare against blueprint and policy rules.
examplePrompt: Review this task result for blueprint alignment, SEO completeness, disclosure, progress update requirement, and unsupported claims.
exampleOutput: PASS with notes, or FAIL with required fixes.
failureModes: Checking style instead of acceptance criteria
whenNotToUse: When there is no task definition
When specialized legal/security review is required
saferAlternative: Require both test result and QA result before DONE.

name: AI Testing Skill
shortDescription: Run project checks and record command evidence before work moves to QA.
longDescription: A testing skill for type checks, builds, route checks, sitemap checks, and structured test reporting in a file-driven agent workflow.
problemSolved: Solo builders need repeatable verification instead of relying on vibes before shipping.
credentialRequirement: None for local checks.
humanApprovalBoundary: Do not mark tasks DONE until Chat Agent reviews failed or skipped checks.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Run local scripts only; do not deploy from testing tasks.
examplePrompt: Run typecheck and build for this task, then write a testing.md result with commands and status.
exampleOutput: npm run typecheck PASS; npm run build PASS; route smoke check pending.
whenNotToUse: When no runnable checks exist and manual inspection is enough
saferAlternative: Testing agent cannot modify code or deploy.

name: AI Customer Support Reply Skill
shortDescription: Draft support replies from customer messages, policy notes, and account context.
longDescription: A customer support skill for solo founders who need fast, consistent replies while keeping sensitive or refund-related decisions under human approval.
problemSolved: Support messages interrupt deep work, but fully automated replies can create trust and policy problems.
credentialRequirement: Support inbox access may require credentials.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human approval required before sending replies involving refunds, cancellations, legal issues, or sensitive customer data.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Start in draft-only mode with fake tickets.
examplePrompt: Draft a calm support reply using this policy. Do not promise refunds or account changes.
exampleOutput: A draft reply with an approval-required flag.
whyUseThis: It keeps the founder in control of risky decisions
whenNotToUse: When support volume is tiny
When messages involve legal, payment, or safety issues
saferAlternative: Draft-only support assistant.

name: AI Lead Research Skill
shortDescription: Research target accounts and summarize why each lead may be relevant.
longDescription: A sales research skill for solo operators who need structured lead notes before outreach without spending hours browsing company pages manually.
problemSolved: Manual lead research is slow, but outreach without context performs poorly.
credentialRequirement: CRM access optional.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human review required before sending outreach.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use a small public lead list and do not send messages automatically.
examplePrompt: Research this company and summarize whether it fits our sponsor target profile. Use only public information.
exampleOutput: Company summary, relevance reason, possible outreach angle, source URLs.
whyUseThis: It supports sponsor and affiliate growth
whenNotToUse: When you cannot verify sources
When outreach would violate platform rules
saferAlternative: Public-source-only research with manual approval.

name: AI SEO Brief Skill
shortDescription: Turn a target keyword into a structured page brief with intent, sections, FAQ, and internal links.
longDescription: An SEO planning skill for creating page briefs that connect keyword intent, decision guidance, internal links, and monetization opportunities.
problemSolved: Publishing without search intent creates content that may be useful but hard to discover.
credentialRequirement: None.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human review required for keyword priority and claims.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Generate briefs before drafts, not after pages are written.
implementationSteps: Draft title, meta description, and sections.
examplePrompt: Create an SEO brief for 'OpenClaw vs Zapier' with decision blocks and internal links.
exampleOutput: Brief with search intent, H2 sections, FAQ, related content, and CTA ideas.
whenNotToUse: When the page is private or not meant to rank
saferAlternative: Require brief approval before drafting public pages.

name: AI Affiliate Tracker Skill
shortDescription: Track affiliate targets, approval status, URLs, and pages where each tool should appear.
longDescription: An affiliate operations skill for keeping monetization work visible without inventing approvals or scattering links across pages.
problemSolved: Affiliate-first sites need a source of truth for programs, statuses, links, and disclosure requirements.
credentialRequirement: Partner dashboards may require credentials, but local tracking can start without them.
humanApprovalBoundary: Human must verify program approvals and paste official URLs.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use placeholder status values and never label unapproved links as affiliate links.
implementationSteps: Mark status as not_applied, applied, approved, rejected, or active.
Map tools to comparison and workflow pages.
Update pages only when URLs are approved.
examplePrompt: Audit affiliate target status and list which comparison pages need approved URLs.
exampleOutput: Tool, status, target page, next action, disclosure requirement.
whenNotToUse: When the site has no monetization plan
When all links are intentionally non-commercial
saferAlternative: Require a status field before any CTA appears.

name: AI Deployment Smoke Test Skill
shortDescription: Check key production routes, sitemap, robots, and visible page content after deployment.
longDescription: A deployment validation skill for solo builders who need a repeatable post-deploy check before submitting pages to search engines.
problemSolved: Production can break differently from local builds, especially SEO routes and static assets.
credentialRequirement: None for public route checks.
humanApprovalBoundary: Chat Agent decides whether to accept deployment and submit sitemap.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Run against preview deployment before production.
implementationSteps: Check metadata and visible page content.
examplePrompt: Check these production routes and report status, title, meta description, and sitemap availability.
exampleOutput: /skills 200 OK; /sitemap.xml 200 OK; robots.txt allows expected pages.
failureModes: Submitting sitemap before routes are stable
whyUseThis: It creates evidence before public indexing
whenNotToUse: Before a deploy URL exists
saferAlternative: Require preview route checks before production.

name: AI Command Center Memory Skill
shortDescription: Keep project decisions, assumptions, progress, tasks, and results in durable files.
longDescription: A memory skill for reducing context loss in agent-driven work by storing decisions, constraints, progress, task files, and result evidence in a command-center folder.
problemSolved: AI work often loses continuity when decisions live only in chat.
notFor: projects that already have mature issue tracking and documentation
credentialRequirement: None.
humanApprovalBoundary: Chat Agent controls master files and final acceptance.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Start with non-secret project notes only.
examplePrompt: Update project progress after this task and record what changed, what is still not done, and the next recommended steps.
exampleOutput: Snapshot, completed work, not done yet, latest progress log.
failureModes: Letting subagents edit master control files
whyUseThis: It turns chat work into an operating system
whenNotToUse: When the project is too small for persistent coordination
saferAlternative: Keep secrets out and restrict master file edits to the Chat Agent.

name: Content Calendar Manager Skill
shortDescription: Plan, schedule, and track content publication across multiple channels and formats.
longDescription: A content management skill for creating editorial calendars, tracking publication schedules, and ensuring consistent content output across blogs, social media, and email newsletters.
problemSolved: Solo operators struggle to maintain consistent content schedules without dedicated marketing teams.
credentialRequirement: API access for publishing platforms if automated.
humanApprovalBoundary: Content approval before publication.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Start with local calendar files before connecting to publishing APIs.
implementationSteps: Define content pillars and target frequency.
Audit existing content and identify gaps.
Create calendar template with themes and deadlines.
Set up tracking for publication and performance.
Establish review process for content quality.
examplePrompt: Create a 3-month content calendar for a SaaS blog focusing on productivity tools.
exampleOutput: Monthly themes, weekly topics, publication dates, and content types with assigned deadlines.
whenNotToUse: When you have a full marketing team
For one-off content pieces
saferAlternative: Schedule reviews before publication.

name: Social Media Scheduler Skill
shortDescription: Plan, create, and schedule social media content across multiple platforms with optimal timing.
longDescription: A social media automation skill for developing content strategies, creating platform-specific posts, and scheduling publication for maximum engagement.
problemSolved: Solo operators can't maintain consistent social media presence without dedicated social teams.
credentialRequirement: Social media API keys and posting permissions.
humanApprovalBoundary: Content and posting schedule approval.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Test with draft posts before live publishing.
implementationSteps: Define social media goals and target audience.
Research platform best practices and algorithms.
Create content themes and posting schedule.
Set up performance tracking and optimization.
examplePrompt: Create a weekly social media schedule for a B2B SaaS company on LinkedIn and Twitter.
exampleOutput: Daily posting schedule with content types, optimal timing, and engagement goals.
whenNotToUse: When you have a social media manager
For highly visual or creative content
saferAlternative: Use platform scheduling tools with approval workflows.

name: Email Marketing Campaign Skill
shortDescription: Design, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns for lead nurturing and customer retention.
longDescription: An email automation skill for creating campaign strategies, writing compelling copy, segmenting audiences, and analyzing performance to improve conversion rates.
problemSolved: Solo operators need email marketing but lack the time and expertise for sophisticated campaigns.
credentialRequirement: Email platform API access and audience data permissions.
humanApprovalBoundary: Campaign content and sending approval.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Test campaigns with small segments before full rollout.
implementationSteps: Define campaign objectives and target audience.
Segment email list based on behavior and demographics.
Create email sequence with compelling copy and CTAs.
Set up automation triggers and follow-up sequences.
Monitor performance and optimize for better results.
examplePrompt: Design a lead nurturing campaign for a SaaS trial signups.
exampleOutput: 5-email sequence with welcome, onboarding, feature highlights, and conversion emails.
whenNotToUse: When you have a marketing team
For highly regulated industries
saferAlternative: Start with small test campaigns.

name: Data Analysis Reporter Skill
shortDescription: Analyze business data and generate actionable insights with visualizations and recommendations.
longDescription: A data analysis skill for processing business metrics, creating reports, and providing strategic recommendations to improve performance.
problemSolved: Solo operators collect data but lack time to analyze it for actionable insights.
credentialRequirement: Access to data sources and analytics platforms.
humanApprovalBoundary: Report distribution and strategic decisions.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use sample data before connecting to live business data.
implementationSteps: Define key metrics and data sources.
Set up data collection and cleaning processes.
examplePrompt: Analyze website traffic data and provide recommendations for improving conversion rates.
exampleOutput: Traffic analysis report with conversion funnel visualization and optimization recommendations.
whenNotToUse: When you have a data analyst
For simple manual reporting
saferAlternative: Use aggregated data to protect individual privacy.

name: Customer Feedback Analyzer Skill
shortDescription: Collect, analyze, and categorize customer feedback to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
longDescription: A customer insights skill for processing feedback from multiple sources, identifying patterns, and generating actionable recommendations for product and service improvements.
problemSolved: Solo operators receive feedback but lack systematic ways to analyze and act on it.
credentialRequirement: Access to feedback data and customer information.
humanApprovalBoundary: Action items and product changes.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use anonymized sample feedback for testing.
implementationSteps: Create regular reporting and trend identification.
examplePrompt: Analyze customer feedback from support tickets and surveys to identify top improvement areas.
exampleOutput: Feedback analysis report with sentiment trends, common themes, and prioritized action items.
failureModes: Failing to close the feedback loop
whenNotToUse: When you have a customer success team
For immediate customer service needs
saferAlternative: Use aggregated insights without individual customer data.

name: Invoice Payment Processor Skill
shortDescription: Automate invoice creation, payment processing, and financial record-keeping for small businesses.
longDescription: A financial automation skill for generating invoices, processing payments, tracking receivables, and maintaining financial records.
problemSolved: Solo operators waste time on manual invoicing and payment tracking.
credentialRequirement: Payment processor API keys and financial data access.
humanApprovalBoundary: Invoice sending and payment processing.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use test/sandbox accounts before live financial transactions.
implementationSteps: Create invoice templates and automation rules.
Set up financial reporting and reconciliation.
examplePrompt: Set up automated invoicing for monthly subscription services.
exampleOutput: Automated invoice generation, payment collection, and overdue reminders.
whenNotToUse: When you have an accountant
For complex financial situations
saferAlternative: Use reputable payment processors with strong security.

name: Meeting Note Taker Skill
shortDescription: Record, transcribe, and summarize meetings with action items and follow-up tracking.
longDescription: A meeting productivity skill for capturing discussions, extracting key decisions, assigning action items, and ensuring follow-through.
problemSolved: Solo operators struggle to capture meeting details and track action items.
credentialRequirement: Meeting platform access and recording permissions.
humanApprovalBoundary: Action item assignment and distribution.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Test with recorded sample meetings.
implementationSteps: Set up meeting recording and transcription.
Create action item extraction and assignment.
examplePrompt: Transcribe and summarize a product strategy meeting with action items.
exampleOutput: Meeting transcript, key decisions, assigned action items, and follow-up schedule.
whenNotToUse: For highly sensitive topics
When real-time participation is required
saferAlternative: Use secure recording platforms and limit access.

name: Code Review Assistant Skill
shortDescription: Analyze code changes for bugs, security issues, and improvement opportunities.
longDescription: A development skill for reviewing code submissions, identifying potential issues, suggesting improvements, and ensuring code quality standards.
problemSolved: Solo developers lack code review partners for quality assurance.
credentialRequirement: Repository access for code analysis.
humanApprovalBoundary: Code change acceptance and implementation.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Review sample code before production use.
implementationSteps: Configure code analysis tools and rules.
Set up automated checking for pull requests.
Implement security scanning and vulnerability detection.
Generate review reports and improvement suggestions.
examplePrompt: Review a pull request for a web application and identify potential issues.
exampleOutput: Code review report with bug fixes, security concerns, and improvement suggestions.
whenNotToUse: When you have a development team
For experimental code
saferAlternative: Use established linting and security tools.

name: Product Backlog Prioritizer Skill
shortDescription: Analyze feature requests, user feedback, and business goals to prioritize product development.
longDescription: A product management skill for evaluating feature requests, assessing business impact, and creating prioritized development roadmaps.
problemSolved: Solo product owners struggle to prioritize features without data-driven frameworks.
credentialRequirement: Access to product management tools and data.
humanApprovalBoundary: Roadmap and prioritization decisions.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use sample feature requests for testing frameworks.
implementationSteps: Assess business impact and technical feasibility.
Create development roadmap and release planning.
examplePrompt: Prioritize a product backlog of 20 features for the next quarter.
exampleOutput: Prioritized feature list with impact scores, effort estimates, and release recommendations.
whenNotToUse: When you have a product manager
For very small projects
saferAlternative: Include stakeholder review in prioritization process.

name: Compliance Checker Skill
shortDescription: Monitor business operations and content for regulatory compliance and risk management.
longDescription: A compliance skill for reviewing business practices, content, and operations against relevant regulations and industry standards.
problemSolved: Solo operators need compliance monitoring but lack legal expertise.
credentialRequirement: Access to compliance resources and business data.
humanApprovalBoundary: Compliance decisions and remediation actions.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Use sample scenarios before production compliance monitoring.
implementationSteps: Set up monitoring systems and alerts.
examplePrompt: Review website content for GDPR compliance and identify potential issues.
exampleOutput: Compliance audit report with identified issues and remediation steps.
whenNotToUse: When you have legal counsel
For highly specialized regulations
saferAlternative: Consult legal professionals for complex compliance issues.
